description: YEIDA allots 289 acres for 1 GW carbon-free facility, targets full operational capacity by 2030
body_lead: AM Group has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Invest UP to set up a one-gigawatt (GW) high-performance computing (HPC) and artificial intelligence (AI) data centre in the state with a proposed investment of about $25 billion. According to the official statement, the project will come up in the Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority (YEIDA) area. Its Chief Executive Officer, Rakesh Kumar Singh, handed over the Letter of Intent to representatives of AM Group on Thursday.
